description: List filler and recap episodes to skip, mixed episodes to keep, and separate novel adaptations. Novel adaptation: Adapted from an official novel, not the manga. Optional for manga-canon viewers, but not anime-original filler. Covers a small reviewed set of series and says so when a series is not covered. Episode numbers only, no plot details. Give a title or a catalog ID.

mal_id.description: The catalog ID from a title search (the same number MyAnimeList uses). Use it instead of a title when you have it.

title.description: The show's name, in English or romaji, for example "Attack on Titan".
